interaction.prompt: The other team has the puck in your corner. Drag each of your three players to where they belong: cover the net-front and the slot, and put pressure on the puck.

feedback.right: That's tight coverage: your D has the net-front, your centre protects the slot, and your winger pressures the puck. The dangerous ice is taken away.
feedback.wrong: Goals come from the net-front and slot. Cover the house first — D to the net-front, centre in the slot — then pressure the puck on the wall.

tip: In your own zone, cover the most dangerous ice first: net-front, then slot, then pressure the puck.
why: Defensive-zone coverage protects the middle. Bodies at the net-front and slot take away the highest-percentage chances before you chase the puck.
